title: Asking About Road Signs
situation: A pedestrian asks a traffic officer what the road signs mean before crossing the street.
somali_situation: Qof lugaynaya ayaa sarkaal taraafiko weydiinaya macnaha calaamadaha waddada ka hor inta uusan waddada goyn.
key_phrases: What do these road signs mean?
The warning sign means slow down.
Is this road safe to cross?
I see the speed limit sign.
Which direction should I walk?

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.english: Excuse me, what do these road signs mean?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, calaamadahan waddadu maxay ka dhigan yihiin?

dialogue.speaker: Traffic Officer
dialogue.english: The warning sign means slow down.
dialogue.somali: Calaamadda digniintu waxay ka dhigan tahay in la gaabiyo.

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.english: Is this road safe to cross?
dialogue.somali: Waddadan ma ammaan baa in la gooyo?

dialogue.speaker: Traffic Officer
dialogue.english: Not yet. Traffic is still moving.
dialogue.somali: Weli maya. Taraafikadu weli way socotaa.

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.english: I see the speed limit sign.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan arkayaa calaamadda xadka xawaaraha.

dialogue.speaker: Traffic Officer
dialogue.english: Yes, the speed limit is twenty miles per hour.
dialogue.somali: Haa, xadka xawaaruhu waa labaatan mayl saacaddii.

dialogue.speaker: Pedestrian
dialogue.english: Which direction should I walk?
dialogue.somali: Jihadee ayaan u socdaa?

dialogue.speaker: Traffic Officer
dialogue.english: Walk left, away from the driving lane.
dialogue.somali: Bidix u soco, kana fogow haadka baabuurta.

title: Finding the Right Hospital Area
somali_title: Meesha saxda ah ee isbitaalka oo la helayo
situation: A patient asks a hospital volunteer what the reception, waiting area, quiet zone, and restricted signs mean.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa mutadawac isbitaal weydiinaya macnaha calaamadaha soo-dhoweynta, goobta sugitaanka, aagga aamusan, iyo meelaha xaddidan.
key_phrases: Does this hospital sign point to reception?
The waiting area is through that door.
What does quiet zone mean?
Visitors should speak softly here.
Restricted means patients cannot enter.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Excuse me, does this hospital sign point to reception?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, calaamaddan isbitaalku ma waxay tilmaamaysaa soo-dhoweynta?

dialogue.speaker: Volunteer
dialogue.english: Yes. Reception is straight ahead.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Soo-dhoweyntu waa si toos ah hore.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Where should I sit after I check in?
dialogue.somali: Xaggee ayaan fadhiistaa marka aan is diiwaangeliyo kadib?

dialogue.speaker: Volunteer
dialogue.english: The waiting area is through that door.
dialogue.somali: Goobta sugitaanku waxay ka dambeysaa albaabkaas.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: What does quiet zone mean?
dialogue.somali: Maxay ka dhigan tahay aag aamusan?

dialogue.speaker: Volunteer
dialogue.english: Visitors should speak softly here.
dialogue.somali: Booqdayaashu waa inay halkan si hoose ugu hadlaan.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: And that red sign says restricted.
dialogue.somali: Calaamaddaas casna waxay leedahay xaddidan.

dialogue.speaker: Volunteer
dialogue.english: Restricted means patients cannot enter.
dialogue.somali: Xaddidan waxay ka dhigan tahay in bukaanku geli karin.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will go to reception first.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Marka hore soo-dhoweynta ayaan tegi doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Volunteer
dialogue.english: You're welcome. The nurse will call your name.
dialogue.somali: Waad mudan tahay. Kalkaalisadu magacaaga way yeeri doontaa.

title: Following Airport Signs
situation: A traveler asks an airport assistant how to follow departure, security, gate, and baggage claim signs.
somali_situation: Socdaale ayaa caawiye garoon weydiinaya sida loo raaco calaamadaha bixitaanka, amniga, albaabka diyaaradda, iyo meesha boorsooyinka laga qaato.
key_phrases: Does this airport sign mean departures?
Follow departures first, then security.
Your gate number will appear after security.
Baggage claim is for arrivals.
Will the signs show my gate?

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Excuse me, does this airport sign mean departures?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, calaamaddan garoonku ma waxay ka dhigan tahay bixitaanka?

dialogue.speaker: Airport Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes. Follow departures first, then security.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Marka hore raac bixitaanka, kadibna amniga.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Will the signs show my gate?
dialogue.somali: Calaamaduhu ma muujin doonaan albaabka diyaaraddayda?

dialogue.speaker: Airport Assistant
dialogue.english: Your gate number will appear after security.
dialogue.somali: Lambarka albaabkaaga wuxuu soo muuqan doonaa amniga kadib.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: I also see a sign for baggage claim.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan kaloo arkayaa calaamad meesha boorsooyinka laga qaato.

dialogue.speaker: Airport Assistant
dialogue.english: Baggage claim is for arrivals.
dialogue.somali: Meesha boorsooyinka laga qaato waxaa loogu talagalay dadka soo degaya.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: So I should not go there now?
dialogue.somali: Markaa hadda halkaas ma tegin?

dialogue.speaker: Airport Assistant
dialogue.english: No, not unless you are meeting someone from arrivals.
dialogue.somali: Maya, ilaa aad qof ka imanaya meesha soo-degista la kulmayso mooyaane.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Where is the security line?
dialogue.somali: Safkii amnigu xaggee buu yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Airport Assistant
dialogue.english: Turn right and follow the blue airport signs.
dialogue.somali: Midig u leexo oo raac calaamadaha buluugga ah ee garoonka.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.english: Thank you. I was walking toward the wrong sign.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Waxaan u socday calaamad khaldan.

dialogue.speaker: Airport Assistant
dialogue.english: You're on the right path now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda jidka saxda ah ayaad ku socotaa.

title: Reading School Signs at Pickup
somali_title: Calaamadaha dugsiga oo la akhrinayo marka ilmo la qaadayo
situation: A parent follows school signs during afternoon pickup and asks a staff member about the main office, visitor badge, cafeteria, staff-only hallway, and evacuation map.
somali_situation: Waalid ayaa raacaya calaamadaha dugsiga marka ilmaha la qaadayo galabtii, wuxuuna shaqaale weydiinayaa xafiiska weyn, calaamadda booqdaha, maqaayadda dugsiga, marin shaqaalaha keliya ah, iyo khariidadda daadgureynta.
key_phrases: I am here for pickup.
The school sign says main office.
Please wear this visitor badge.
That hallway is staff only.
The evacuation map shows emergency exits.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Excuse me, I am here for pickup.
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, waxaan u imid inaan ilmo qaado.

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: Welcome. The school sign says main office.
dialogue.somali: Soo dhowow. Calaamadda dugsigu waxay leedahay xafiiska weyn.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Should I go there first?
dialogue.somali: Ma halkaas ayaan marka hore tagaa?

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: Yes. Please wear this visitor badge.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Fadlan xidho calaamaddan booqdaha.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: The pickup sign points to the cafeteria.
dialogue.somali: Calaamadda qaadistu waxay tilmaamaysaa maqaayadda dugsiga.

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: Correct. Parents meet children by the cafeteria doors.
dialogue.somali: Waa sax. Waalidiintu carruurta waxay kula kulmaan albaabbada maqaayadda dugsiga.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Can I use that hallway?
dialogue.somali: Ma isticmaali karaa marinkaas?

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: No, that hallway is staff only.
dialogue.somali: Maya, marinkaas waa shaqaalaha oo keliya.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: I also see an evacuation map on the wall.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan sidoo kale derbiga ku arkayaa khariidad daadgureyn.

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: The evacuation map shows emergency exits.
dialogue.somali: Khariidadda daadgureyntu waxay muujisaa albaabbada degdegga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Do visitors need to know that?
dialogue.somali: Booqdayaashu ma u baahan yihiin inay taas ogaadaan?

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: Yes, in case the alarm sounds.
dialogue.somali: Haa, haddii qaylo-dhaantu dhawaaqdo.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Thank you. The signs make more sense now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Calaamaduhu hadda way ii caddaadeen.

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: Good. Follow the blue pickup arrows.
dialogue.somali: Waa wanaagsan tahay. Raac fallaadhaha buluugga ah ee qaadista.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: I will check out at the main office after pickup.
dialogue.somali: Qaadista kadib waxaan ka bixi doonaa xafiiska weyn.

dialogue.speaker: School Staff
dialogue.english: Thank you. That keeps the school record correct.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taasi waxay diiwaanka dugsiga ka dhigaysaa mid sax ah.

title: Noticing a Safety Sign
situation: A shopper asks a staff member about wet floor, danger, and exit safety signs.
somali_situation: Qof wax iibsanaya ayaa shaqaale weydiinaya calaamadaha badbaadada ee sagxad qoyan, khatar, iyo albaabka laga baxo.
key_phrases: What does this safety sign mean?
It says wet floor.
Please be careful.
Does danger mean do not enter?
The exit is on the left.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Excuse me, what does this safety sign mean?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, calaamaddan badbaadadu maxay ka dhigan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Staff Member
dialogue.english: It says wet floor.
dialogue.somali: Waxay leedahay sagxad qoyan.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Should I walk around it?
dialogue.somali: Ma inaan hareer maraa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff Member
dialogue.english: Yes, please be careful.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan taxaddar.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Does danger mean do not enter?
dialogue.somali: Khatar ma waxay ka dhigan tahay ha gelin?

dialogue.speaker: Staff Member
dialogue.english: Yes, do not go past that sign.
dialogue.somali: Haa, ha dhaafin calaamaddaas.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Where is the exit?
dialogue.somali: Albaabka laga baxo xaggee buu yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Staff Member
dialogue.english: The exit is on the left.
dialogue.somali: Albaabka laga baxo wuxuu ku yaal bidixda.

title: Finding a Meeting Room
situation: A visitor asks a receptionist how to read office signs for reception, a meeting room, staff entrance, and waiting area.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa soo-dhoweeye weydiinaya sida loo akhriyo calaamadaha xafiiska ee soo-dhoweynta, qolka kulanka, albaabka shaqaalaha, iyo goobta sugitaanka.
key_phrases: Does this office sign mean reception?
The meeting room is upstairs.
That door is the staff entrance.
Visitors should wait in the waiting area.
Please sign in at reception first.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Excuse me, does this office sign mean reception?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, calaamaddan xafiisku ma waxay ka dhigan tahay soo-dhoweyn?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Yes. Please sign in at reception first.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Fadlan marka hore soo-dhoweynta iska saxiix.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I have a meeting in Room 204.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan kulan ku leeyahay Qolka 204.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: The meeting room is upstairs.
dialogue.somali: Qolka kulanku wuxuu ku yaal dabaqa kore.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Can I use that door?
dialogue.somali: Ma isticmaali karaa albaabkaas?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: No, that door is the staff entrance.
dialogue.somali: Maya, albaabkaasi waa albaabka shaqaalaha.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Where should visitors wait?
dialogue.somali: Booqdayaashu xaggee bay ku sugaan?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Visitors should wait in the waiting area.
dialogue.somali: Booqdayaashu waa inay ku sugaan goobta sugitaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will follow the signs upstairs.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Waxaan raaci doonaa calaamadaha dabaqa kore.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Good. Room 204 is on the right.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Qolka 204 wuxuu ku yaal midigta.

title: Reading Hotel Signs After Check-In
somali_title: Calaamadaha hoteelka oo la akhrinayo isdiiwaangelin kadib
situation: A guest asks hotel reception about signs for the lift, breakfast room, housekeeping, and do not disturb.
somali_situation: Marti hoteel joogta ayaa soo-dhoweynta weydiinaysa calaamadaha wiishka, qolka quraacda, nadiifinta qolka, iyo ha la carqaladeyn.
key_phrases: I just finished check-in.
Does this hotel sign point to the lift?
The breakfast room is on the ground floor.
Housekeeping starts after nine.
Do not disturb means no one will knock.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: I just finished check-in.
dialogue.somali: Hadda ayaan dhammeeyey isdiiwaangelinta.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Great. Your room is on the fourth floor.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Qolkaagu wuxuu ku yaal dabaqa afraad.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Does this hotel sign point to the lift?
dialogue.somali: Calaamaddan hoteelku ma waxay tilmaamaysaa wiishka?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Yes, the lift is past the lobby.
dialogue.somali: Haa, wiishku wuxuu ka dambeeyaa hoolka.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Where is the breakfast room?
dialogue.somali: Qolka quraacdu xaggee buu ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: The breakfast room is on the ground floor.
dialogue.somali: Qolka quraacdu wuxuu ku yaal dabaqa hoose.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: The sign on my door says housekeeping.
dialogue.somali: Calaamadda albaabkayga ku taal waxay leedahay nadiifinta qolka.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Housekeeping starts after nine.
dialogue.somali: Nadiifinta qolalku waxay bilaabataa sagaalka kadib.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: What if I hang the do not disturb sign?
dialogue.somali: Haddii aan sudho calaamadda ha la carqaladeyn maxaa dhacaya?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Do not disturb means no one will knock.
dialogue.somali: Ha la carqaladeyn waxay ka dhigan tahay qofna ma garaaci doono.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: That helps. I will use it tonight.
dialogue.somali: Taasi way i caawisay. Caawa ayaan isticmaali doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Of course. Enjoy your stay at the hotel.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Ku raaxayso joogitaankaaga hoteelka.

title: Understanding Sale and Return Signs
somali_title: Calaamadaha qiimo-dhimista iyo celinta oo la fahmayo
situation: A shopper asks a sales assistant about sale, fitting room, final sale, returns, checkout, and out of stock signs before buying a jacket.
somali_situation: Qof wax iibsanaya ayaa kaaliyaha dukaanka weydiinaya calaamadaha qiimo-dhimista, qolka cabbirka, iibka kama dambaysta ah, celinta, bixinta lacagta, iyo alaab dhammaatay ka hor inta uusan jaakad iibsan.
key_phrases: Does this sale sign include jackets?
The fitting room is at the back.
Final sale means you cannot return it.
Returns are accepted within fourteen days.
Checkout is near the front door.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Excuse me, does this sale sign include jackets?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, calaamaddan qiimo-dhimistu ma ku jirtaa jaakadaha?

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, all blue jackets are on sale.
dialogue.somali: Haa, dhammaan jaakadaha buluugga ah qiimo-dhimis bay ku jiraan.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Can I try this one on?
dialogue.somali: Kan ma cabbiri karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: Of course. The fitting room is at the back.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Qolka cabbirku wuxuu ku yaal gadaasha.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: This tag says final sale.
dialogue.somali: Kaarkan wuxuu leeyahay iib kama dambays ah.

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: Final sale means you cannot return it.
dialogue.somali: Iib kama dambays ah waxay ka dhigan tahay inaadan celin karin.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: What about the green jacket?
dialogue.somali: Jaakadda cagaaran se?

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: That size is out of stock.
dialogue.somali: Cabbirkaas wuu naga dhammaaday.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: If I buy a regular item, can I return it?
dialogue.somali: Haddii aan alaab caadi ah iibsado, ma celin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes. Returns are accepted within fourteen days.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Celinta waa la aqbalaa afar iyo toban maalmood gudahood.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Where is checkout?
dialogue.somali: Meesha lacagta lagu bixiyo xaggee bay ku taallaa?

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: Checkout is near the front door.
dialogue.somali: Meesha lacagta lagu bixiyo waxay ku dhowdahay albaabka hore.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will take the blue jacket.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Jaakadda buluugga ah ayaan qaadanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: Good choice. Keep the receipt with you.
dialogue.somali: Doorasho fiican. Rasiidkaaga hayso.

dialogue.speaker: Shopper
dialogue.english: Even for sale items?
dialogue.somali: Xataa alaabta qiimo-dhimista ku jirta?

dialogue.speaker: Sales Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, the receipt explains the return rules.
dialogue.somali: Haa, rasiidku wuxuu sharxayaa xeerarka celinta.

title: Reading a Warning Sign
somali_title: Calaamad digniin ah oo la akhrinayo
situation: A visitor asks a worker about a warning sign near a closed sidewalk.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa shaqaale weydiinaya calaamad digniin ah oo ku dhow laami dadka lugeeya oo xiran.
key_phrases: What does this warning sign mean?
The sidewalk is closed.
Something could be falling.
Where is the safe path?
Follow the orange signs.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Excuse me, what does this warning sign mean?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, calaamaddan digniintu maxay ka dhigan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.english: The sidewalk is closed.
dialogue.somali: Laamiga dadka lugeeya wuu xiran yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Is it dangerous?
dialogue.somali: Ma khatar baa?

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.english: Yes. Something could be falling.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Wax ayaa soo dhici kara.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Where is the safe path?
dialogue.somali: Jidka ammaanka ah xaggee buu yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.english: Follow the orange signs.
dialogue.somali: Raac calaamadaha liimiga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will not use this sidewalk.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Laamigan ma isticmaali doono.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.english: Good. Please stay behind the barrier.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Fadlan xayndaabka gadaashiisa joog.

title: Following Emergency Signs
situation: A visitor asks a security guard what to do if the alarm sounds and how to follow emergency exit, assembly point, and first aid signs.
somali_situation: Booqde ayaa ilaaliye weydiinaya waxa la sameeyo haddii qaylo-dhaantu dhawaaqdo iyo sida loo raaco calaamadaha albaabka degdegga ah, goobta la isugu yimaado, iyo gargaarka degdegga ah.
key_phrases: What should I do if the alarm sounds?
Follow the emergency exit sign.
The assembly point is outside, near the car park.
First aid is beside reception.
Call emergency services if someone is hurt.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Excuse me, what should I do if the alarm sounds?
dialogue.somali: Raalli ahow, maxaan sameeyaa haddii qaylo-dhaantu dhawaaqdo?

dialogue.speaker: Security guard
dialogue.english: Follow the emergency exit sign.
dialogue.somali: Raac calaamadda albaabka degdegga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: Where does it lead?
dialogue.somali: Xaggee bay ku geynaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Security guard
dialogue.english: It leads to the stairs and then outside.
dialogue.somali: Waxay ku geynaysaa jaranjarada kadibna bannaanka.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: What is the assembly point?
dialogue.somali: Goobta la isugu yimaado waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Security guard
dialogue.english: The assembly point is outside, near the car park.
dialogue.somali: Goobta la isugu yimaado waa bannaanka, meel u dhow baarkinka.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: I see a first aid sign too.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan sidoo kale arkaa calaamad gargaar degdeg ah.

dialogue.speaker: Security guard
dialogue.english: First aid is beside reception.
dialogue.somali: Gargaarka degdegga ah wuxuu ku yaal soo-dhoweynta agteeda.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.english: And if someone is hurt?
dialogue.somali: Haddii qof dhaawacmo se?

dialogue.speaker: Security guard
dialogue.english: Call emergency services if someone is hurt.
dialogue.somali: Wac adeegyada gurmadka haddii qof dhaawacmo.
